platform: Radio K / KUOM Official Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Radio K authorizes physical releases and digital submissions to its Music Department. Digital delivery must use a linked .zip file on Google Drive, Dropbox or a similar service with the highest-quality files available, preferably lossless WAV or FLAC; Bandcamp download codes or free-release links are also accepted. The official email is protected in the rendered page and was not decoded or copied into the automated dataset. A human must open the official page, confirm the live address, verify rights and link permissions, prepare the required metadata and avoid prohibited tracking follow-ups.

platform: WPRB 103.3 FM Official Music Director Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WPRB publicly authorizes music submissions by email to music@wprb.com and accepts CDs, CD-Rs, LPs, 12-inch, 10-inch and 7-inch physical media, with physical submissions explicitly prioritized. The page does not publish complete digital attachment, download-link, metadata or clean-edit requirements. A human must choose the route, confirm current digital delivery expectations before sending assets, verify rights and prepare any physical package.

platform: KALX 90.7 FM Official Physical-Only Airplay Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KALX currently accepts only physical, professionally pressed CDs or LPs for airplay consideration. It explicitly rejects downloads, file transfers, Bandcamp or Spotify links, YouTube videos, CD-Rs and other digital formats. Although music@kalx.berkeley.edu is publicly listed for the Music Directors, the official instructions do not authorize digital delivery to that mailbox. A human must verify that the release is professionally pressed, prepare the physical package and use the published postal destination exactly.

platform: KVRX 91.7 FM Official Digital and Physical Airplay Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: KVRX directs all airplay submissions to music@kvrx.org and states that it currently accepts both physical and digital submissions. It also explicitly rejects AI-assisted or AI-generated music. A human must verify that the selected MarcsMusic track complies with that restriction, confirm any missing file, link, metadata and clean-edit requirements with operations@kvrx.org when necessary, and prepare the submission without guessing undocumented specifications.
